name: ORA by Aurem
description: ORA is an autonomous AI software engineer. It connects to a GitHub repository, plans a change, writes the code, runs security scans, and commits to your branches after your approval. Reach it through the MCP endpoint below (Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0). There is no separate A2A JSON-RPC endpoint.

skills.name: Ship code to GitHub
skills.description: Submit a concrete file-edit task. ORA plans, writes the code, runs security scans, and commits to GitHub after approval.
examples: Add a /api/health route to backend/routers/health.py returning {ok: true}

skills.name: List projects
skills.description: List connected GitHub repositories for the authenticated user.

skills.name: Get task status
skills.description: Check the status of a task or Loop run, including the commit SHA when shipped.
examples: What is the status of task t_abc123?

skills.name: Get recent commits
skills.description: Get recent commit history from the project GitHub repo.
examples: Show recent commits for my project

bearer.description: JWT from auremcto.com login, or a long-lived API key starting with sk-aurem- issued via POST /api/aurem-dev/mcp/keys.
